_about: Learned live on pcserverandparts.com (BigCommerce, 'PCSP') on 2026-10-29: scratch/pcsp/probe_category.py, probe_rows.py. Every listing row/card carries data-entity-id (product id) and data-sku.

listing.description: One listing. Three layouts: product card (article.card: 'Was: $461.99 | $193.02 | 10 in stock | Add to cart'), ready-system row (.pcspRdy__row: specs | price | stock | Add to cart), build-your-own row (.pcspByoL__row / card with 'FROM $X | Custom build | Configure' = a base price, not a complete system).

listing_title.description: Title on product cards; ready/BYO rows have no title element - their text is the title.

listing_link.description: Product page link (rows are themselves <a href> for BYO).

add_to_cart.description: 'Add to cart' - presence = buyable as listed. READ ONLY - NEVER clicked.

next_page.description: Next page link (none on the pages probed).

site_search.description: Header search field (BigCommerce). Ready signal of every page; searches go by URL (search.php?search_query=).
